scope.interpretation: PartNet-Mobility is a fixed articulated-object dataset, not a generation method. This arm measures prompt-only global top-1 retrieval and must not be merged into the same-prompt generation ranking.

benchmark.prompt_policy: After the opaque render snapshot is locked, use each exact complete English prompt string without rewriting, category filtering, or access to spec files.

dataset.terms_summary: Non-commercial research and education only; research colleagues must first accept the terms; a for-profit employer is also bound; ShapeNet terms also apply.
dataset.units: PartNet geometry is normalized to a unit sphere and does not preserve real-world metric scale.
dataset.redistribution_policy: Keep raw selected assets and generated renders internal. Report only metrics, protocol details, and cryptographic hashes unless derivative-output rights are separately confirmed.

source_audit.formal_gate: The source auditor must validate this exact amendment and an independently written ready PASS audit before creating any formal private output.
source_audit.archive_closure: Reject unsafe, duplicate-normalized, or symlink ZIP members. Stream SHA-256 every regular archive member and its corresponding extracted regular file, require equal bytes and hashes, then require exact archive/extracted path-set closure.
source_audit.geometry_scene: Parse source URDF only in the private source phase. Emit one geometry-only scene per opaque candidate containing only numeric zero-position transforms, opaque geometry blob relative paths, and blob SHA-256 values. Emit no link, joint, visual, semantic, category, source asset identity, target, or benchmark information.
source_audit.geometry_blob: For every archive-bound referenced OBJ, create geometry_blobs/<sha256>.obj as an internal hardlink or byte copy and verify its SHA-256. Renderer access to original source asset paths is forbidden.
source_audit.render_plan: Sorted ascending by opaque candidate key. Scene paths must be relative geometry_scenes/<candidate_key>.json and cannot be absolute or contain parent traversal.

renderer.replay_requirement: All 8 PNG SHA-256 values and the complete worker runtime fingerprint must be identical for every candidate across both fresh runs.
renderer.scene: Zero-joint-position geometry from the private geometry-only manifest; +Y up; azimuths 0,45,...,315 degrees; elevation 22.5 degrees; orthographic per-object AABB framing with 1.32 margin; fixed gray-blue rough dielectric; fixed camera-aligned directional light plus ambient; white background.
worker_allowed_inputs: relative geometry-only scene path and SHA-256
opaque geometry blob relative paths, hashes, and numeric transforms
worker_forbidden_inputs: link, joint, visual, semantic, or category names

opaque_snapshot.candidate_inventory_forbidden: No source ID/path, source binding contents, URDF, geometry, bounds, extents, renderable count, part name, category, target, prompt, spec, or prior score.
opaque_snapshot.phase_boundary: The exact opaque snapshot is SHA-256 locked before the selector may read the frozen prompts.

retriever.view_aggregation: Extract a float32 512-D feature per view, convert to float64, independently L2-normalize each view, arithmetic-mean the 8 views, then L2-normalize in float64.
retriever.text_feature: Use the exact full prompt with deterministic CLIP tokenizer truncation at 77 tokens, extract float32 feature, convert to float64, and L2-normalize.
retriever.selection: Global top-1 over all 2347 eligible assets; no category filter.
retriever.tie_break: Descending exact float64 score, then ascending opaque candidate key.
retriever.replay_requirement: Both full asset and prompt embedding arrays, tokenization/index metadata, and 18-row top-1 selection must be byte-identical.

materialization.phase_boundary: Only after the selection lock exists may materialization open the private opaque-key-to-source binding and selected URDFs.
materialization.selected_source: The exact source mobility.urdf bound by candidate key and pre-render SHA-256.
materialization.unit_interpretation: The resulting coordinates remain normalized dataset units and must not be interpreted as meters despite the generic canonicalizer field name.
materialization.failure_policy: Any selected source or canonicalization failure is a task failure; do not select another rank and do not rescale to a target.

primary: eligible render coverage over 2347 fixed candidates
reporting.numeric_reason: PartNet-Mobility geometry is unit-sphere normalized without recoverable metric scale. All 20 numeric constraints are individually marked not applicable. Target-driven rescaling is forbidden.
reporting.count: The existing name-matched renderable-node count is a supplementary proxy only, not semantic exact-count ground truth. It may be reported as N/R if structure/name granularity is judged unreliable.
reporting.required_label: PartNet-Mobility prompt-only CLIP retrieval (fixed-dataset reference; not generation)
reporting.not_allowed: Do not report numeric failures as zero, merge this arm into the same-prompt generation headline, or describe selected assets as generated.

observation_budget_comparability.partnet_mobility: Eight synthetic 256x256 views under the protocol above.
observation_budget_comparability.physx_mobility: The paired PhysX fixed-dataset arm is required to use the same eight synthetic 256x256 view budget for direct dataset-reference comparison.
observation_budget_comparability.artiverse: The completed Artiverse arm used sixteen dataset-native views. It is a separate fixed-dataset reference with a different observation budget; no retriever-capacity or dataset-ranking conclusion may be drawn directly between it and the two synthetic-eight-view arms.

execution_gate: Before any formal private source output or render exists, an independent pre-result auditor must write a ready PASS audit and bound report into the otherwise empty selection_and_result root. Each subsequent phase independently revalidates the exact amendment and relevant implementation/audit hashes.
